rows.assessment: The production request calls _client_pool_for, which normalizes and tracks the state directory before client creation/request even if absent. The focused missing-directory test uses the real pool registration but mocks _state_files and stop_native_resident; it does not start or retire a real resident. The native_resident_client atexit handler closes streams only, intentionally preserving the shared resident. Full explicit cleanup exists, but no current production import of the old native_runtime_resident atexit owner was found. Installed cleanup probes can fall back to explicit Rust stop, so their success alone would not prove registration-owned process retirement.
rows.action: Leave unresolved for a bounded real resident lifecycle witness and clarification of the shutdown owner; do not replace shared-resident ownership with per-hook unconditional stop.
